help.details:
Available commands:
  welcome  - welcome message after installation
  check    - system diagnostics, JSON report
  repair   - fix filesystem/config (does not touch DB)
  sql      - execute or reset app SQL files

Install and reset: sudo bash vendor/Opus/bin/install.sh | sudo bash vendor/Opus/bin/reset.sh

check.details:
Checks directories, permissions, DB connection, roles, schemas and tables.
Saves report to config/setup_report.json

repair.details: Fixes missing directories and permissions. Does not modify the database.

sql.message: Execute or reset application SQL files
sql.details:
Usage: php index.php setup sql <create|reset> <app-name>

  create  - execute all SQL files for the application
  reset   - drop application schema (CASCADE)

app.details: Check the apps array in global.json

schema_parse.message: CREATE SCHEMA statement not found in: $value$
schema_parse.details: File must contain: CREATE SCHEMA [IF NOT EXISTS] "schema_name"
